description: This Java source file defines the TaxRatesController class, which manages HTTP requests related to tax rates in the admin section of a sales management web application. It includes methods for listing, paginating, creating, updating, editing, and deleting tax rate entities, along with validation and auxiliary setup functions.

classes.name: TaxRatesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rate operations in the admin interface, including CRUD functionalities, validation, and list paging.

methods.name: displayTaxRates
methods.description: Handles the GET request to display the list view of tax rates, initializing model attributes with country, tax rate, and tax class data for rendering.

methods.name: pageTaxRates
methods.description: Processes the POST request to provide a JSON response containing a paginated list of tax rates, formatted for client-side display.

methods.name: saveTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new tax rate after validation, updating the list view accordingly.

methods.name: updateTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing tax rate after validation, showing success or errors.

methods.name: removeTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a tax rate by ID with proper validation and JSON response.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Prepares the model for editing an existing tax rate, populating fields with current data.

methods.name: validateTaxRate
methods.description: Performs validation on the TaxRate object, checking required fields, code uniqueness, and setting related references.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the active menu context for the admin UI.
